g.text: Assumes L = 100 W m⁻² sr⁻¹ µm⁻¹, optics × detector efficiency 0.4, dwell = GSD / ground speed.
Push-broom imagers make up the shortfall with TDI; frame cameras (Dove, SkySat) stack several frames.
